subject.title: fix(ci): honor Kova performance report contracts

question: Should the maintainer-owned release-performance CI contract fix land after exact-head checks pass?
rationale: The patch is a small, correct-looking CI/release-validation fix, but the protected `maintainer` label and workflow surface make landing an explicit maintainer action rather than a cleanup decision.

options.title: Merge after exact-head checks
options.body: Land the PR once current-base required checks are green because source and dependency review support the fix shape.

options.title: Hold for more release proof
options.body: Ask for a fresh OpenClaw Performance run or additional Testbox transcript before merge if maintainers want release-lane proof beyond the existing PR evidence.

options.title: Rework the Kova contract upstream
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want Kova to change its flag/report schema contract instead of adapting OpenClaw's trusted adapter.

recommendation.title: Merge after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Land the PR once current-base required checks are green because source and dependency review support the fix shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assignee, is recognized by the proof workflow as an active maintainer-team member, and has recent history on the performance workflow.
